summary: Incyte Corp. filed an 8-K reporting its definitive agreement to acquire Vega Therapeutics, a wholly owned subsidiary of Star Therapeutics. Incyte will pay $1.25 billion upfront, with up to $750 million in additional sales milestone payments, for total potential consideration of up to $2.0 billion. The deal adds VGA039, a Phase 3 monoclonal antibody targeting Protein S for von Willebrand disease. No advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. The transaction is subject to customary closing adjustments, with no regulatory clock specified. Watch for antitrust review and completion timeline; risk-arb centers on milestone achievability.
